## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.2.0

Terminal now runs inside the main window. Type commands and answers in its input box while viewing the collector's output in the Terminal tab. The standalone console option remains available from the same EXE with `--terminal`.

The banner has a visible Version Information button. The workbook footer can copy the active workbook path or open its folder. The published EXE is named `USB Drive Inventory Collector.exe`.
